question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who is filled with excessive enthusiasm
solution:
The correct answer is: **Extrovert**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"enthusiasm"** means intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval. (उत्साह)

 
 
• **Example: **Her enthusiasm for the project was contagious, inspiring everyone to give their best.
 
 
 
• **"Extrovert"** refers to a person who is outgoing and socially confident. (बहिर्मुखी)
 
 
• **Example: **John is an extrovert who loves meeting new people and attending social gatherings.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that a person who is filled with excessive enthusiasm is often an extrovert.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Extrovert**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Horticulturist** (बागवानी विशेषज्ञ): A person who is skilled in garden cultivation and management.

 
 
• **Example:** The** horticulturist** gave us valuable tips on how to grow roses in our garden.
 
 
 
• **Introvert** (अंतर्मुखी): A person who is shy, reserved, and tends to be inward-turning.
 
 
• **Example: **Mary is an **introvert** who prefers spending time alone reading books.
 
 
 
• **Narcissist** (आत्ममुग्ध): A person who has an excessive interest in or admiration of themselves.
 
 
• **Example:** His** narcissistic **behavior made it difficult for him to maintain relationships.
 
 

49:Tc17,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
